meta.parties: De Silva v. De Silva Et Al

rules.statement: Sections 325 and 326 of the Civil Procedure Code do not apply to an order for delivery of possession under section 287, as such an order is considered an 'order' rather than a 'decree'.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, section 217 provides that a decree or order may command the person against whom it operates (c) to yield up possession of immovable property, and therefore we have to ascertain what provision is made for the enforcement of an order under head (c) of section 217. It will be noticed that the word is 'order' and not 'decree.'"
